分完地，林国强揣着三百块钱回了家。

当天晚上，他跟赵素梅商量了一件事。

“素梅，我想把咱家这房子修一修。”

赵素梅正在灯下纳鞋底，听了这话，手里的针顿了一下。

“修房子？得花不少钱吧？”

“我算过了，屋顶翻一遍，换几根椽子，再糊一层泥，大概百十来块。

墙上的裂缝补一补，窗户换成玻璃的，不用多，两扇就够。

加起来一百五打住了。”

赵素梅皱了皱眉，心疼钱，但她没说什么。

这房子确实该修了。

去年冬天，西北风从墙缝里灌进来，林薇那时候还小，冻得直哭。

她用棉被把窗户堵上，屋子里黑得像地窖。

“那……剩下的钱呢？”她小心翼翼地问。

“剩下的，我有其他用途。”

林国强没有细说。

第二天一早，他就去镇上买了材料。

椽子、油毛毡、玻璃、石灰、洋灰，杂七杂八地装了满满一板车，借了生产队的驴拉回来。

赵素梅站在门口，看着那一车材料，心疼得直抽抽。

“国强，这得多少钱啊？”

“不贵，百十块。”

“百十块还不贵？分家总共才分了三百块……”

“素梅，”林国强把一袋洋灰从车上卸下来，拍了拍手上的灰，“钱是王八蛋，花了还能赚。

你和孩子住得舒坦，比什么都强。”

赵素梅不说话了，眼眶红红的，转身进屋给他倒了一碗凉白开。

修房子用了四天。

林国强一个人干，没请帮工。

不是舍不得请，是不想欠人情。

在村里，请人帮忙就得管饭，管饭就得有肉有酒，一来二去，花的比请工人还多。

他先把屋顶的瓦片全部掀了，把烂掉的椽子抽出来换上新的，铺上一层油毛毡，再盖上瓦片。

这道工序最累人，爬上爬下的，膝盖上的旧伤隐隐作痛，但他咬着牙没吭声。

然后把墙上的裂缝用石灰填平，内外都刷了一遍白灰。

屋子小，刷起来快，半天就完事了。

最费工夫的是窗户。

After dividing the land, Lin Guoqiang returned home with 300 yuan in his pocket.

That night, he discussed something with Zhao Sumei.

"Su Mei, I want to repair our house."

Zhao Sumei was picking up the soles of her shoes under the lamp. After hearing this, the needle in her hand paused.

"Repairing a house? It will cost a lot of money, right?"

"I have calculated that it will cost about a hundred or ten yuan to renovate the roof, replace a few rafters, and apply a layer of mud.

Repair the cracks in the wall and replace the windows with glass ones. You don’t need more, just two.

The total added up to one hundred and fifty."

Zhao Sumei frowned, feeling sorry for the money, but she didn't say anything.

This house really needs some repairs.

Last winter, the northwest wind came in through the cracks in the wall. Lin Wei was still young at that time and cried from the cold.

She blocked the windows with quilts, and the room was as dark as a cellar.

"Then... where is the remaining money?" she asked cautiously.

"I have other uses for the rest."

Lin Guoqiang did not elaborate.

Early the next morning, he went to the town to buy materials.

A cart full of rafters, linoleum, glass, lime, and cement was borrowed from the production team to pull it back.

Zhao Sumei stood at the door, looking at the cart of materials, feeling heartbroken.

"Guoqiang, how much does this cost?"

"It's not expensive, a hundred and ten yuan."

"Isn't a hundred and ten yuan expensive? The total division of the family was only three hundred yuan..."

"Su Mei," Lin Guoqiang unloaded a bag of cement from the car and patted the dust on his hands, "Money is a bastard, you can still make money after spending it.

You and your children can live comfortably, which is better than anything else."

Zhao Sumei stopped talking, her eyes were red, and she turned around and went into the room to pour him a bowl of cold water.

It took four days to repair the house.

Lin Guoqiang worked alone without hiring any help.

It’s not that I’m reluctant to ask, it’s that I don’t want to owe a favor.

In the village, if you ask for help, you have to take care of the food, and to take care of the food, you have to provide meat and wine. Going back and forth will cost more than hiring workers.

He first tore off all the tiles on the roof, took out the rotten rafters and replaced them with new ones, laid a layer of linoleum felt, and then covered them with tiles.

This process was the most tiring. As he climbed up and down, the old injuries on his knees ached, but he gritted his teeth and said nothing.

Then the cracks in the wall were filled with lime, and the inside and outside were painted with white plaster.

The house is small, so it can be painted quickly, and it can be done in half a day.

The most labor-intensive part is the windows.
